body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.0016797549561255445213356709939207025769…(3046 digits)**. Capped phase-cell fusion outer (PR1673, Vlado Vojdanovski) on this repository's T74 supplier (pivot-566 and pivot-554 helper-donor kernels, certified complex endpoint 0.00167975495612554452133567...), free strict slacks at 1e-3010 or below, with fine source-prime padding (PR1786, chafreaky / Chafik Boukhalfa, via Tim Trudgian's prime theorem; vendored) which makes the grouped chirp guard beta + 2 xi - 2 < 1, the fractional-shift gauge-free interiors with accretive shallow circuits (PR1758, outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md), the radix-distributed union schedule with per-visit tag work, and the explicit Strassen boundary. New here: epsilon is a free parameter of the PR1786 ledger (every row holds for every 1-epsilon > 1e-3010), so the explicit point is epsilon = 1 - 2e-3010, beta = 1 - 6e-3010, giving kappa = 0.00167975495612554452133567099392070257..., 3.4e-3013 below the supplier's complex saving q, hence the ceiling of any outer of this form (outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md). 62 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls, an independent balance derivation with an epsilon sweep, PR1786's finite prime/underflow controls and the gauge-free identity checks are regenerated; the supplier's full native admission is rerun. Conditional, with all inherited all-size hypotheses and the cited prime theorem; the fine-padding lemmas (PR1786 is a draft) and the composition need independent review; asymptotic margins are 2e-3010. Endpoint recertification: native and conservative complex endpoints refined to 1e-3000 (accept at endpoint, reject at endpoint + 1e-3000) with the repaired fine engines evaluated in directed-rounding integer fixed point; kappa exceeds PR1897 by 2.00336e-500, PR1876 by 8.11857e-401, PR1875 by 6.06686e-301 and PR1839 by 6.56133e-91 (62 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls).

## Verification

Fresh checkout of `34bb6fe148cf878b707b5bf22b8a225206780a67`. Manifest: `7e19f0aa64708ac354bcb1f0ba1635be286b42579096b6b8dd60e5e38444b4b8`.
PASS package manifest: 381 files

Supplier: the package's own unchanged `verify.py` (retained PR1297 provider and parent admission, owner reconstruction, parent lift, strict T74 admission, geometry controls): `PASS_T74_EXACT_FILL_COMPLETE_FINITE_ADMISSION`, native reuse {'base': 'e8e6e78ff7422275c38324499e1f33fb2ecd30de9503aef2b8f1ee80d8c4df8e', 'extra': '7b0e9fbda32749aabc7e156d9fe09bceb0624a178628fe69e5dfea783462f905'}; its complex endpoint 419938739031386130333917748480... brackets the ledger's b = 1679754956125544521335670993920702576998…(3008 digits)/1000000000000000000000000000000000000000…(3011 digits). Outer (PR1673 capped phase-cell fusion): regenerated exact ledger (62 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls incl. the old g-factor union row, the old linear and old-theta chirp guards, the old 2*beta tag test, epsilon at 1 or at the r0 slack and beta outside its window, larger endpoint rejected by the native moment), independent balance derivation, the exact union-schedule simulation, the (retained, not used for kappa) structured-boundary displacement-rank check, the gauge-free identity/symbol/circuit checks, PR1786's finite prime/underflow controls and 19 exact evidence replays all pass. Conditional kappa 0.0016797549561255445213356709939207025769…(3046 digits) (union schedule outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md; explicit Strassen boundary tau=45/16 (the structured boundary of outer/STRUCTURED-BOUNDARY.md is not used); gauge-free interiors outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md; fine source-prime padding PR1786 at the free point epsilon=1-2e-100, outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md).

Full package-owned verification passed in 118.1 seconds. The fresh receipt binds the exact package manifest and score.

See `research/capped-fusion-t74-k554/README.md` for reproduction commands and proof qualifications.

## Credits

Jeremy Kothe and contributors (PR1731 ledger lineage, radix-union schedule), LeverRank (independent schedule simulation), Gohberg, Semencul, Kailath, Kung, Morf, Bitmead, Anderson, Pan (structured Toeplitz-like algorithms of the retained alternative), Francois Le Gall et al. and Chafik Boukhalfa (PR1699). Supplier: PR1625 (mdumitrean), PR1661 (midhatn), pivot-554 kernel (PR1672 lineage) and the PR1319/PR1297/PR1274/PR1286 lineage as in earlier packages. PR1897 (M6LI), PR1876, PR1875 and PR1828 (rohanarun): the endpoint and slack refinements that this package exceeds; rohanarun also PR1319 and PR1297; chafreaky PR1786; Vlado Vojdanovski PR1673; mdumitrean PR1625; midhatn; philippeVV PR1519 (odd-term Mercator finding); Kothe and the existing lineage.



## Bootstrap-cutoff carry (PR1956, Josie Elliston)

The earlier head used the uncarried cutoffs max(ceil(36/gap^2), ceil(2(4+512)/gap)), which omit the carried constant C_old*2^(L*(a_{j+1}-a_j)) of the cutoff lemma (PR387; FINITE_BIT_ACCOUNTING.md); finding and repair (a) are from PR1956 by Josie Elliston. This head carries the previous constant into every stage's cutoff (ell_{j+1} = max(512, ell_j + ceil(L_j*(a_{j+1}-a_j))) + 1, both lemma inequalities asserted exactly in integers at proof time for every stage of both branches), and a control asserts that the uncarried cutoffs fail the carry rule from stage 2 on. kappa is unchanged (it is computed from the chain end only).



## Lemma G label / adapter stage (PR1964, thakrarsagar)

The frame-only local replay accepts three physically wrong adapter mutants (X exit straddle, Y entry straddle, Z exit adapters moved before a phase-B add). This head adds stage `lemmag-labels` beside it (`code/lemmag_stage.py`, `code/lemmag_checks.py` vendored verbatim from PR1964 by thakrarsagar / Sagar Thakrar; Lemma G by DreamingOfClouds, PR509 / PR516): `label_check` (strict and permissive) and `adapter_rule` must report 0 violations on every provider's LOCAL-PROGRAMS in both orientations, and the three mutants must be rejected. Full proof passed with the stage.
